name: Bottom sheet
title: Bottom sheet
summary: Three heights on a native modal dialog, with a handle that is a real button so the heights work without dragging.
description: The phone sheet, with heights a keyboard can reach.
how: The handle is a real button with a name, not a decorative bar: dragging is the extra, because a keyboard cannot drag and many hands cannot either.

name: Loading button
title: Loading button
summary: aria-busy and aria-disabled rather than the disabled attribute, so the focus and the state survive the wait.
description: A button that says what it is doing, and keeps your place.
how: Never the disabled attribute: disabling the focused button throws focus to the page body, so the place is lost and nothing is announced. aria-disabled says the press will do nothing instead.

name: Undo snackbar
title: Undo snackbar
summary: A way back from an action, with a clock that stops while you are using it and can be turned off entirely.
description: Undo, with a time limit that is actually adjustable.
how: The clock stops while the snackbar is hovered or focused, and nought seconds never runs at all — a limit that cannot be extended fails WCAG 2.2.1.

name: Inline confirm
title: Inline confirm
summary: The question replaces the button in its own row, with focus on the safe answer and Escape as the way out.
description: Are you sure, without a dialog over the page.
how: Focus lands on the cancel answer, so a stray Enter after the first press does nothing; the row keeps its height, so nothing shifts out from under a pointer.

name: Circular progress
title: Circular progress
summary: A ring that reads back its value with a unit, prints the number, and carries no value at all when it does not know one.
description: A progress ring that never invents a number.
how: Indeterminate means no aria-valuenow at all — inventing a number is a lie about the state — and the number is printed on the face, because a partly filled arc is not information.

name: Error state with retry
title: Error state with retry
summary: Names what failed, says whether anything changed, offers a retry, and hides the technical line behind a disclosure.
description: A failure you can actually do something about.
how: A focusable region rather than role=alert — an alert reads the whole panel over everything else and leaves no way back to it — and focus lands on the panel so the reason is read before it is retried.

name: Maintenance notice
title: Maintenance notice
summary: A real time window, what will and will not work, and a dismissal remembered even where storage throws.
how: A region landmark rather than a live region — the notice is already there when the page loads, so nothing would be announced — and sticky rather than fixed, so it keeps its own space on a phone.

name: Help hint
title: Help hint
summary: Long help behind a named button that stays open, and joins the field's description while it is.
description: The help behind the question mark, done as a disclosure.
how: A disclosure, not a tooltip: hovered help cannot be read twice, cannot be copied from, and barely exists on a touch screen. While it is open it joins the field's description.
